packageRules.description: One PR per manager for non-breaking updates. Breaking is decided by each versioning (Cargo semver for crates, so 0.x minors are breaking). matchUpdateTypes keeps majors out regardless, since github-actions versioning reports every upgrade as non-breaking.
Skip crate releases whose rust-version is newer than constraints.rust.

Move every Rust toolchain reference (rust image, rust-toolchain.toml, rust-version, CI toolchain, constraints.rust) together. All resolve against the Docker Hub rust tags so only versions the builder image has are proposed. Must come after the non-breaking rule so this groupName wins.
dtolnay/rust-toolchain version refs are branches, not tags; the custom manager below tracks them.
The built-in rust-toolchain manager tracks Rust releases, which land before the rust Docker image.
The renovate-config manager tracks constraints.rust against Rust releases; the custom manager below tracks it with the rest of the toolchain instead.
rust-version is the published MSRV, so it and the CI toolchain are raised by hand rather than following the latest Rust.

customManagers.description: Rust toolchain version in rust-toolchain.toml, Cargo.toml rust-version, CI toolchain refs/inputs, and constraints.rust in renovate.json.
